$comment: Device profiles — the form factors a run can capture. `npm run capture` asks which ones
to use; --device <id> (repeatable), --all-devices or DEVICES=a,b answer without asking.
The id is a folder name: screenshots/<id>/<module>/<flow>/<step>.<mode>.png, and it is part
of the fingerprint key, so each device keeps its own change-detection baseline.
viewport is the BROWSER viewport, not a screen resolution (a 1920x1080 monitor shows about
1920x950 once browser chrome is subtracted, and few CSS breakpoints act above ~1440).
emulate borrows a real device's user agent from Playwright's descriptors; null means a plain
desktop browser. isMobile/hasTouch decide whether the app serves its mobile layout at all —
a wide viewport with isMobile: true would still be a phone capture.
dpr is the pixel density; the C1 evidence gate checks every captured frame against it.
